data.one_liner: A wrapper around dropdown_search to use with reactive_forms.
data.what_it_does: It connects the dropdown_search package with reactive_forms to allow searchable dropdown fields inside reactive form groups. It manages form control values and state automatically.
use_when: You are building forms with reactive_forms and need a searchable dropdown.
You want seamless form validation and value access for dropdown selections.
avoid_when: You are not using reactive_forms in your application.
You prefer standard Flutter dropdowns without search capabilities.
strengths: Integrates search functionality seamlessly with reactive_forms validation and state management.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Documentation is minimal and currently in progress.
Strictly coupled to reactive_forms and dropdown_search packages.
